bar: OOS compounded return > 0 net of costs
largest single-asset share of total positive P&L contribution <= 50%
one-sided t-test on OOS period returns: Bonferroni p < 0.05 / N_global, N_global = 2000 (floor; p within 2x of the threshold either way counts as FAILED)
at 2x costs: compounded > 0 AND per-period PF >= 1.2
cost_mechanism: At each rebalance, sum_i |w_new,i - w_drifted,i| charged at RT_i/2 per asset leg, deducted from the new period's return. Initial build from cash charged. Cash earns 0.
rule: At each rebalance date t, score = trailing L-calendar-day return (last close <= t vs last close <= t-L; each endpoint bar within 3 calendar days of its target date; asset needs >= L+30 days of history). Hold top-K at equal weight 1/K. long_only: always invested. long_flat: a selected asset with score <= 0 is held as cash, weight NOT redistributed. Fewer than K eligible: unfilled weight stays cash in both modes.
